cloud_objective_summary.csv.definition: 35 historical scale-method cells plus 15 separate-rerun cells (full, direct5400, direct6000); source and repetition columns retain provenance. Pointwise 95% seed-cluster percentile intervals, 50,000 shared-index draws, PCG64 seed 20260912. Historical total scoring calls follow the archived accounting; additional-study calls are instrumented.

cloud_objective_contributions.csv.definition: Mean paired per-instance 100*w_k*(f_k(s_g)-f_k(s))/c_k, in percentage points; w_k=0.25; components are rounded archived records.

cloud_components_summary.csv.definition: All 7 methods, all 5 task scales (200, 500, 1000, 2000, 5000), 4 absolute metrics; mean and sample SD (ddof=1) over 30 seeds. Figure task-count axis is logarithmic; numerical coordinates and metric values are unchanged.

fig8_direct_refinement.csv.definition: Three separate-rerun method rows. Component reductions are 100*(1-pooled metric mean/pooled Greedy-LPT reference mean); F reduction is 100*(1-mean F). Five timing repetitions provide one deterministic quality observation per block.

additional_source.scope: Separate 20260924 rerun at W0_equal/default_4_to_1, 50 VMs; never pooled with historical quality rows.
